topic: Citizen Algorithmic Rights Biometric and AI Transparency Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 14, Article 21, Seventh Schedule List I Item 31, Item 97

official_sources.pinpoint: Article 14, Article 21 (Right to Privacy - K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India)

findings.limitations: Right to privacy and protection against arbitrary biometric exclusion as held in K.S. Puttaswamy (Aadhaar) (2019) 1 SCC 1.

gaps: DPDP Act 2023 lacks explicit prohibitions on mass facial recognition and public sector AI algorithmic bias audits.
